title: Cancellation and Reinstatement Terms by Product, Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
A companion booking made on Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is cancelled on the terms of the product it was booked on:

| Term | Certificate Main Cabin | Certificate Main Plus | Certificate Premium Economy | Certificate First | Pass Semiannual | Pass Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancelling an unflown companion booking returns the trip | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Cancellation cutoff for the trip to be reinstated, in elapsed hours before the first scheduled departure | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Reinstatement fee after a voluntary cancellation (USD) | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 0 | 0 |
| Reinstated trip keeps the original book-by date | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Cancelling the holder's ticket automatically cancels the companion's | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Form in which the companion fare and taxes are refunded on a cancellation | original form of payment | original form of payment | original form of payment | original form of payment | original form of payment | original form of payment |
| Calendar days added to the book-by date when Crestline cancelled the companion's flight after the book-by date passed | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Reading the terms

- The product's reinstatement fee is 50 USD on each of the four certificates and 0 USD on both passes.
- The cutoff of 1 hour is counted back from the first scheduled departure of the companion booking.
- The refund form is the original form of payment on every product; no product refunds the companion fare and taxes as a flight credit.
- The extension of 30 calendar days concerns trips reinstated because Crestline cancelled the companion's flight.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Crestline Companion Certificate First booking whose first flight is scheduled to depart at 18:00 has its cancellation cutoff at 17:00 the same day. On a Crestline Companion Pass Annual the product's reinstatement fee is 0 USD.
